name: Omarchy Top Bar Plus
author: Adrian Garcia Riera
description: Keeps the Omarchy top bar hidden and slides it in when you touch the top edge of a monitor. It shows over your windows, tiled or fullscreen, without pushing them, and hides again when you move away. Per monitor, nothing running at rest, and windows tagged no-bar-peek keep the edge for their own bar. Easy on OLED screens: no static bar burning in.
